Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
RawProcessId
The operating system’s internal PID. For matching, use the UPID fields which guarantee a unique process identifier
RawThreadId
The operating system’s internal PID. For matching, use the UPID fields which guarantee a unique process identifier
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
ContextThreadId
UTID of thread originating this event
RawTargetProcessId
TargetProcessId
The unique ID of a target process (in decimal, non-hex format). This field exists in almost all events, and it represents the ID
of the process that is responsible for the activity of the event in focus. For example, the TargetProcessId of a process that
performed thread injection in an InjectedThread event

Size
Size of the egressing file in bytes.
